question: The autobiography, 'An Autobiography' by Jawaharlal Nehru is also known as ____________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Toward Freedom**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Toward Freedom** is the alternate title for Jawaharlal Nehru's autobiography, originally written as **'An Autobiography'**.
 
• The book provides a detailed insight into **Nehru's political journey, personal life, and the freedom struggle of India.**
 
• It was written during Nehru's imprisonment between **1934 and 1935**.
 
• The autobiography highlights his thoughts on **Indian politics, socialism, nationalism, and his vision for India's future.**
 
• It also reflects his perspectives on global political movements and events during the early 20th century.
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru was the **first Prime Minister of India** and a key figure in the Indian independence movement.
 
• The book serves as an important historical document, offering insights into the mindset and philosophy of one of India's prominent leaders.
 
• Nehru's writing style is marked by **clarity, eloquence, and depth of thought.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **My Idea of Education**__

 __
 
• The title **'My Idea of Education'** is not related to Jawaharlal Nehru's autobiography.
 
• It may refer to other writings or works discussing education philosophies, but it is not connected to Nehru's work.
 
 
 
• **The Accidental Prime Minister**__
 __
 
• **'The Accidental Prime Minister'** is a book written by **Sanjaya Baru**, focusing on **Dr. Manmohan Singh's tenure** as India's Prime Minister.
 
• It is unrelated to Jawaharlal Nehru's autobiography.
 
 
 
• **The Unfinished Innings**__
 
 
• **'The Unfinished Innings'** is not associated with Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• It could refer to other works or autobiographies, possibly from sports personalities or political figures.
